title: StudioCommentCreate
description: POST /lessons/:lessonId/items/:item/comments (2.17.0). Saving a comment is not a state change. The Worker stores the text it reads now as the anchor. `proposedText` belongs to one line: the Worker refuses it on a section comment (400 bad_request).

proposedText.description: The corrected text of ONE line. Not accepted when kind is section.

seenHash.description: The previewHash the page was showing (from the comment list). When the text changed since, the Worker refuses with text_changed_since_preview and the page reloads.

clientId.description: Optional idempotency key: the same clientId returns the comment already saved.
